scope: D learner-content organization over accepted canonical Block/KP Core; no medical-Core duplication, no Projection/UI decisions
hard_rules: Original iPad/MarginNote Lecture remains the primary continuous explanatory Source for genuine new Source learning and original visuals.
Canonical Block Markdown remains the sole medical Core owner; this content owner references Core and may not fork or paraphrase a second medical truth.
KianOS Framework content is orientation/compression, not a replacement continuous Lecture.
Canonical KP Detailed Expansion is Core/reveal/repair/reference material; it is not automatically compulsory continuous first-pass KianOS reading.
Logic Group is retrieval/local-closure structure and never creates a Source trip by itself.
Visual-required cognition must use real original-Source visual contact when first formed; text cannot certify a never-seen spatial model.
Source gaps/conflicts remain explicit and fail closed; Content may not repair them from model prior.
Content organization must not add hard prerequisites, inferred question membership, learner progress or UI geometry.

content_layers.ORIENTATION: center problem + minimum map + bounded Framework + attention/ownership boundary before Source contact
content_layers.SOURCE_CONTACT: continuous original Lecture contact at the accepted whole-Block or natural-Source-unit granularity; integration-primary Blocks do not manufacture a new continuous Lecture pass
content_layers.RETRIEVAL: accepted Logic-Group prompts/closures retrieve already-contacted Core without normal Source re-entry
content_layers.CORE_CHECK: canonical KP Core is used to check, explain or repair retrieval; full Core exists because it is medical truth, not because it must all be reread continuously
content_layers.BOUNDARY: Source gaps/conflicts, external-owner boundaries, deferred scope and exact precision remain explicit
content_layers.COMPRESSION: Block Recall and accepted optional PSR/System reconstruction compress already-built models; they do not replace first Source contact

legacy_route_resolution.block_frontmatter.prerequisites: LEGACY_NONAUTHORITATIVE_FOR_D_LEARNER_READINESS; accepted Learning owner system_route.requires is the only D hard-readiness authority
legacy_route_resolution.block_frontmatter.next_blocks: LEGACY_NONAUTHORITATIVE_FOR_D_LEARNER_ROUTE; accepted Learning owner default_route/benefits_from governs learner guidance
legacy_route_resolution.block_intro.first_pass_fixed_flow: MUST_BE_INTERPRETED_THROUGH_ACCEPTED_SOURCE_CONTACT_MODE; whole-Block, natural-Source-unit and integration-primary Blocks do not share one literal Source handoff pattern

before_source: know the Source stop-line and what to notice
do not pre-read full KP expansions as a second Lecture
after_source: retrieve the accepted LG(s) unlocked by that Source contact
use canonical Core only for checking/repair/reference as needed
continue according to accepted Source-contact mode
after_block: Block Recall rebuilds the governing medical problem rather than reciting KP labels
